notes.title: Summer optimization patch for Zemblanity
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

In the recent update I have made optimization changes making the game much smoother. Game should be running more than 2 times better than before.

Thank you and enjoy!

XenOxygen

notes.title: 18th April - inventory change, additional features and bugfixes
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

In todays patch I made changes for the inventory. Then I have done precautions that lantern bug will not happen again in Labyrinth level, added new atmospheric sound effect and one small bonus atmospheric scary event + bugfixes.

Thanks!

notes.title: 10th April - menu and options change, optimization and bugfixes
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

In todays patch I made few changes in menu and options. Also game optimization was done and game performance is now optimized by 50% + made few bugfixes.

Thanks!

notes.title: After-release hot-fix - 4th of April
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

In this hot-fix I have fixed few bugs I have encountered after the game released or were directly reported to me.

- Added more save game locations
- Added warning message in the main menu, which is warning players about save game feature
- Fixed 3-digit pad-lock issue, where it moves you to next level even without entering correct number
- Fixed an issue, where players can glitch inside fallen bookshelf and then they are unable to get back

Thanks everyone for your support!

notes.title: Zemblanity is now RELEASED!
notes.notes:
[h3]Finally, after months and months of my free time my first psychological horror game - Zemblanity is finally released. For me it is great achievement and I hope you enjoy Zemblanity as I enjoyed creating it.[/h3]

In case you find bugs, please report it to me directly or post it in Zemblanity community forum and it will be fixed in next patch!

Will you discover the secrets of Zemblanity and will you find a way out?
